text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O hasn't shown up to training, and I can't get in touch with her. Worried, I set off to look for her.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ah, have you come to meet my reflection in the lake?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Yes… I have never forgotten the visage I first saw in my formative years. And so, I come here to revisit it from time to time.
choice_data_list: And yet, you forgot your training.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Gasp! Wh-what have I done? You have my sincerest apologies.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: To think, the absence of my brilliance… I have left you cowering in the frigid night of loneliness!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: No, stop it! Don't extend the olive branch! For it is I who left you abandoned and alone!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I swear to you now. I shall never leave you ever again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I feel the urge to tease her, but I let it be. At least she understands where she went wrong—in her own way, of course.
